title: `rebalance` uses the wrong balance
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  If the `swapQuantity` parameter is `0`, the `rebalance` function will perform the swap first. After the swap, the balances of `token0` and `token1` in the contract will change.
